adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, `discourse_expires_in 1.minute` is applied unconditionally, including the branch that `render 'loading'` when no topic exists yet. The loading template triggers `document.location.reload()` after 30s, so with a 60s cache lifetime the reload can legitimately return the cached loading response instead of re-running the controller logic to see the newly-created topic, delaying or breaking the intended flow.
